courses.title: Defensible Use of Force: Standards, Decisions, and Documentation
courses.excerpt: STC-certified, on-demand training for California probation officers and supervisors. Master the Sowards 8355 Articulation Framework — the legal foundations, decision-making, perceptual lenses, and documentation that hold up in court and in the moment. Four modules, 100 lessons, capstone written scenario, AI-graded.
courses.audience: California probation officers, juvenile corrections officers, and first-line supervisors.
modules: Module 2 — Pre-Force Decisions and Tactical Considerations (~55 min)
Module 3 — Acute Stress and Decision-Making (~55 min)
Module 4 — Application and Documentation (~75 min, bifurcated by track)

courses.title: De-escalation and Crisis Intervention for Juvenile Institutions
courses.excerpt: California STC-aligned de-escalation and crisis intervention training for juvenile institution staff. Four modules, avatar-led video lessons, knowledge checks, a branching scenario, a written skill test, and a final examination.

courses.title: De-escalation and Crisis Intervention for Probation Field Operations
courses.excerpt: California STC-aligned de-escalation and crisis intervention training for probation field officers (juvenile and adult). Four modules, avatar-led video lessons, knowledge checks, a branching scenario, a written skill test, and a final examination.

courses.title: Preventing Manipulation and Grooming in Juvenile Facilities: Boundaries, Ethics, and Safety
courses.excerpt: California STC-aligned training on preventing manipulation and grooming in juvenile facilities, for line staff, supervisors, and training officers. It teaches professional boundaries, ethics, the warning signs of grooming and manipulation, and safe, defensible practice, with avatar-led video lessons, knowledge checks, scenarios, and a final examination.
